The outer coordinator explicitly keeps stale_qualified/stale_critical_qualified/native_stale_drop_observed/above_high_stale_zero_kill_verified false and exposes only the new limited relief qualification.
Stale predecessor admission now requires a complete critical positive from the same revision, matching fixed unit and externally pinned result; medium-only partial cannot authorize it.
Existing outer cgroup identity, actual InvocationID/PID, monotonic coverage, resource peaks, precise cleanup and Main epoch gates are unchanged.
